PRIVACY & ENQUIRIES

Your project.
Your information.

What happens to the details you share with Hydro-Tec.

The information you enter

The form asks for your name, preferred contact, building suburb and a description of the problem. Additional project details are optional. Please leave out sensitive personal information.

When you send an enquiry

Selecting “Send enquiry” sends your details securely through Amazon Web Services to the developer’s test inbox while this preview is being tested. Use sample project details for testing. If you provide an email address, it is used as the reply-to address.

A private backup

A private copy is stored in AWS in Sydney to help investigate delivery problems and recognise repeat submissions. Only the enquiry reference enters the encrypted delivery queue; failed queue entries are retained for up to 14 days for investigation. Enquiry copies are scheduled for automatic deletion after 30 days; AWS’s deletion process may take a few extra days. The copy delivered to the receiving inbox is managed separately by its owner and email provider.

Spam protection and technical information

The service uses limited technical information to control abuse. Short-lived, hashed network identifiers are scheduled for deletion after two days. Application logs contain enquiry references and delivery status rather than the message content, and are kept for seven days. AWS may also process technical request information to operate the service.

If sending fails

The form keeps your details on the current page so you can retry or choose to send an email yourself. A failed attempt may have a private backup, but the site only shows a success message after the enquiry is saved and accepted into the delivery queue. Temporary email failures are retried automatically. Unresolved deliveries are flagged for the operator. A success message does not guarantee that the receiving email provider has placed it in the inbox.

Website preferences

This site does not currently include advertising, analytics scripts or tracking cookies. Form drafts are not saved to browser storage. The gallery and menu use temporary page state and do not require an account.

Contact

For questions about your information, or to request access, correction or deletion, email Noxy or call 0456 905 187.
